☁️ Independent Advice & Setup · Logan & Surrounds

Cloud Backup & Storage Solutions Logan. The Right Plan, Properly Set Up.

Feeling overwhelmed by cloud backup plans? Computer Repairs Logan helps you choose the right provider, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Backblaze or iDrive, and sets it up securely. No overpriced subscriptions, no confusion, just safe, accessible storage. Prefer to stay off the cloud? We set up local backups too.

Back Up To The Cloud
✓ Platform Comparison
✓ Encrypted Setup
✓ Hybrid NAS + Cloud
✓ Business & Family Plans
Why It Matters

Cloud Storage Isn't Backup Until It's Set Up Properly.

Setting up file exclusions, sync rules and retention policies can be confusing, and there are plenty of horror stories of people locked out of their online accounts entirely. That's where our advisory and setup service adds value, we do the hard work for you, including checking your account security and two-factor setup so you never get locked out.

Our Approach

Platform Comparisons, Not Guesswork.

We break down the features, costs and storage limits of the major providers, help you avoid overpriced or unnecessary subscriptions, and fully configure, install and encrypt your backup system, then train you to restore files and check backup health yourself.

Benefits

Benefits Of Cloud-Based Storage.

🌍

Access Anywhere

Get to your files from any device, anytime, without needing to be at a specific computer.

🔐

Encrypted Security

Most reputable providers use AES-256 encryption to protect your data in transit and at rest.

🕓

Version History

Restore older versions of a file or bring back something you deleted by mistake.

📈

Scalability

Start small and grow your storage as your needs change, without buying new hardware.

🛟

Disaster Recovery

Protect your files from theft, fire, flood or ransomware affecting your physical devices.

🔗

Hybrid Integration

Combine cloud backup with local storage, such as a NAS, for extra resilience.

Know The Trade-Offs

Cloud Backup Isn't Perfect Either.

We help you understand both sides so you can make an informed decision.

📶

Internet Dependence

You need a stable connection for uploads and restores, a slow or unreliable connection affects both.

⏳

Slower Restore Times

Large file recoveries can take hours, especially compared to a local backup on an external drive or NAS.

💳

Ongoing Subscription Costs

Monthly or annual fees add up over time, especially with large volumes of data.

We help you choose providers with strict privacy policies, and comply with the Australian Privacy Act where it's relevant to how your data is stored and handled.

Who It's For

Customised Backup Solutions.

  • Home backup plans. Personal documents, photos and videos.
  • Family sharing. With secure privacy controls between accounts.
  • Business solutions. Secure nightly backups of staff PCs and servers.
  • Hybrid setup. Combining a Synology or QNAP NAS with cloud storage.
  • Photographers & freelancers. RAW file backup with version control, or daily backup of client files and invoices.
  • Seniors. Simple backup with big-button interfaces and clear restore prompts.
Back Up To The Cloud
Related Services

A Complete Backup Strategy.

Prefer local storage or want the best of both worlds? Pair your cloud plan with a home or office NAS setup. Already have files scattered across a computer that's on its last legs? Start with a proper data backup and transfer. If something's already gone missing, our data recovery service may still be able to get it back. And if it's decades of family photos and documents you're trying to get under control, see our photo and document organisation service.

Frequently Asked Questions

Cloud Backup Questions, Answered.

What's the difference between cloud backup setup and just using Google Drive?

Cloud backup setup is a professional service where we choose the right provider, configure scheduled backups, encryption and retention policies, unlike basic file storage where you're left to figure that out yourself.

Can you consolidate multiple cloud accounts into one?

Yes, we can migrate files from Dropbox, OneDrive or other accounts into a single, secure backup location.

What is a hybrid backup strategy?

A hybrid backup combines local NAS speed (Synology or QNAP) with an off-site cloud provider, giving you quick restores plus off-site redundancy.

Can I restore from a ransomware attack?

Often, yes, using version history we can help you roll back to a clean state from before ransomware struck, provided your backups were configured with adequate retention.

Will my photo library back up correctly?

Yes, we use sensible photo backup strategies, such as excluding duplicates and selective folder sync, so your phone or Lightroom photo libraries sync without filling up your plan unnecessarily.

What if my internet connection is unreliable?

We can tailor solutions like throttled backup speeds, offline cache strategies, or a local NAS-plus-cloud combination for intermittent connections.

Unsure Which Backup Plan Is Right For You?

Let us compare the best-value cloud options for your situation, no upsells, just clarity.
